findings.issue: allowed_dependencies incomplete/inconsistent in 8 of 8 manifests. Workspace-internal edges all conform; third-party vocabulary inconsistent (jev-py lists pyo3/serde_json, sc-ai lists sc-observability, others list nothing). Under contract an edge the manifest does not allow is critical.
findings.recommendation: Option B (list every normal dependency) preferred: it makes 'no ureq in sc-ai' / 'no tree-sitter in sc-jev-check' mechanical. Missing: sc-agent-types +sc-observability-types,serde,serde_json,sha2,thiserror,uuid; sc-agent-secrets +keyring,whoami; sc-jev +serde_json,toml,ureq; sc-jev-backends +serde_json,ureq; sc-jev-check +serde,serde_json,toml; sc-treesitter +mimalloc,serde_json,tree-sitter*; sc-ai +mimalloc,serde,serde_json,uuid.

findings.issue: Boundary gate is one opaque sc-lint sc-boundary call; every manifest has empty enforcement.lint_rules, references.forbidden, testing.forbidden_test_bypasses; only 2/8 have any forbidden_edges. What sc-boundary checks is UNVERIFIED (binary not in repo).
findings.recommendation: Add forbidden_edges (sc-treesitter -> sc-jev/sc-jev-backends/sc-jev-check/sc-agent-secrets/ureq; sc-jev <-> sc-jev-backends; sc-jev-check -> ureq/tree-sitter*/pyo3/sc-observability; sc-ai -> ureq/sc-jev/sc-jev-backends; sc-agent-types -> sc-observability/ureq/pyo3; sc-agent-secrets -> ureq); populate references.forbidden; bind lint rule ids or delete empty stanzas; wire validator JSON report into QA.

findings.issue: sc-jev and sc-jev-backends are two parallel ureq HTTPS stacks (own transport trait, req/resp types, retry trait, 8 MiB cap, https-only, redaction, busy retry). Retry-After parsers disagree ('1.5' -> 1.5s vs 30s). Different ADR-SAG-0020 sealing models (&ResolvedApiKey in WireRequest vs install_auth).
options: Extract one neutral HTTP-JSON port (sc-http crate or module in one crate) owning types, cap, https-only, redaction, one Retry-After policy, one sealing model; sc-jev/sc-jev-backends implement only framing
Cheaper: align Retry-After parsing and sealing model now, defer crate extraction

findings.classification: routine_fix (VendorPin deletion) + owner decision (byte cap owner)
findings.issue: Three sources of truth for request limits/model pins: sc-jev-check assets/jev.toml max_input_bytes=200000 + vendor models 'jev','haiku','luna'; sc-jev api/jev.toml model 'jev-1.13.0' max_request_bytes=96000; sc-jev-backends hardcodes HAIKU_MODEL/LUNA_MODEL and 96_000. PackagedConfig.vendors/VendorPin has no consumer outside config and tests. A payload between 96000 and 200000 passes sc-jev-check cap and is refused downstream.
findings.recommendation: Delete VendorPin, PackagedConfig.vendors and [vendors.*]. Decide one owner of the byte cap: pass down from sc-jev-check, or each backend reports its limit via validate_for_send and sc-jev-check stops pre-capping.

findings.issue: Two separate SessionLog -> sc_observability::v2::Logger adapters (sc-ai observe.rs, sc-jev-py logging.rs) field-for-field identical apart from service constant; log-root policies diverge (SC_LOG_ROOT + <repo>/.sc-ai vs SC_AGENT_LOG_DIR > SC_LOG_ROOT > ~/.sc-agent/log).
options: One owner (e.g. sc-agent-obs composition-root helper crate) consumed by both binaries; decide whether sc-ai <repo>/.sc-ai divergence from ADR-SAG-0021 is intentional and document or converge

findings.classification: routine_fix (hardening) + owner decision (where shared git-read lives)
findings.issue: git argument injection via --rev: spec '{rev}:{path}' passed to git show / rev-parse --verify with no --end-of-options and no rev validation; a rev starting with '-' (e.g. --output=FILE) is parsed as an option. 'Read blob at rev' lives twice with divergent hardening (sc-jev-check read_git_show has --end-of-options but not --no-textconv; sc-treesitter has --no-textconv but not --end-of-options).
findings.recommendation: Now: --end-of-options or reject leading '-' in sc-treesitter + regression test. Collapse: shared repo-relative-read-at-rev in sc-agent-types (owns Rev/RepoRoot) or tiny crate; parity test meanwhile.

findings.issue: mimalloc is a normal dep of the library but used only in src/main.rs; every library consumer builds and links it. Same for sc-ai (lower impact).
findings.recommendation: cli feature (default on) enabling dep:mimalloc with required-features on [[bin]]; consumers use default-features=false. Short ADR for = pins on tree-sitter*.

findings.issue: ADR-SAG-0020 sealing is convention only: ResolvedApiKey::as_str and ::new are pub and the type is Clone; any dependent can read or fabricate the secret. Production readers today only sc-jev https.rs:64 and sc-jev-backends transport.rs:79,83.
findings.recommendation: clippy.toml disallowed-methods for ResolvedApiKey::as_str with allow only in the two transports; or sc-boundary references.forbidden; resolve RBQA-F003 sealing model first.

findings.issue: sc-agent-types is a kitchen-sink contract crate (errors, ids, secret, judge port, subjects schema, observability v2 port + sc-observability-types dep). sc-treesitter ('No judge crates') links JudgeBackend, ResolvedApiKey, SessionLog, sc-observability-types, sha2, uuid while using only JevError, Rev, subjects, ScAgentErrorResponse. pub re-export observability::v2::EventError is a third-party type in a public trait signature (temporary per bead agt-obs-v2-shim-removal).
options: Split neutral subjects+error core (sc-treesitter, sc-jev-check, sc-ai) from judge/secret ports and obs port
At minimum ensure shim-removal bead covers EventError and sc-observability-types dep

findings.issue: JudgeOutcome.answers/probabilities/provider_meta are serde_json::Value; EqualInputRecord.commands Vec<String>; payload_bundle_from_value(Value) public. sc-jev check.rs (23 Value hits), sc-jev-backends wire.rs (37), sc-jev-check session rendering each re-parse the same answer shape.
options: Typed answers map (question id -> ChoiceAnswer) validated once at the port; Value only for provider_meta; typed backend command enum

findings.issue: Visibility wider than facades: sc-jev pub mod api/client + root re-exports (two public paths); sc-jev-backends exposes UreqTransport/HttpRequest/HttpResponse/RetrySleeper/timeouts; sc-ai exports observe items, Clock, ExecuteOverrides; sc-jev-py re-exports pyo3-typed wrappers and helpers; sc-jev-check::registry::backend_key_id pub; facades incomplete for sc-jev-check/sc-treesitter.
findings.recommendation: Private api/client modules keeping root re-exports; drop pub from backend_key_id; update facade strings; narrow features for test needs.
